name: dns-san-embedded-nul-evades-constraint-invalid
description: permittedSubtrees dNSName is example.com. The leaf has a dNSName SAN whose value contains an embedded NUL byte: the bytes spell 'example.com', then 00, then 'evil.com'. RFC 5280 7.2 dNSName comparison treats the IA5String value as a whole; the full byte string is not equal to example.com and is not a subdomain of it, so the leaf must be rejected. A validator that copies the IA5String into a C string and compares with strcmp/strncmp will see 'example.com' (truncated at the NUL) and incorrectly accept, smuggling 'evil.com' past the constraint.
notes: Mirror of email-embedded-nul-san-invalid but for dNSName. Constructed via the unknown_extensions raw-DER escape hatch because dNSName SANs are also IA5String and cryptography may reject embedded NULs at the higher-level x509.DNSName API.
